info.title: Integration API
info.description: The Integration API provides an easy way to integrate your system and start creating, updating and cancelling orders rapidly. 🚀

            as such, make sure to provide the Authorization header with a valid value.

post.description:
Creates a new order in the system. Even though an order is created successfully, the response can return an array
            named "validationErrors" containing errors that will need to be addressed. Note that Basic Authentication is required for all requests
            as such, make sure to provide the Authorization header with a valid value. Should you choose to provide a callback url by
            using the 'WebhookUrl' field, we will send a HTTP POST request to that URL with a JSON payload containing the OrderId when
            the order is either delivered or cancelled.

example.PickupNotes: Please make sure that the number of items of the order is correct.
example.DropoffNotes: Please make sure to deliver the right number of items.

post.description:
Create a return order in the system. Even though an order is created successfully, the response can return an array
            named "validationErrors" containing errors that will need to be addressed. Note that Basic Authentication is required for all requests

404.description: No order found that matches the sourceOrderId

500.description: An error occurred when trying to create the return order

post.summary: Create a new order from a template
post.description:
Creates a new order from a template. Even though an order is created successfully, the response can return an array
            named "validationErrors" containing errors that will need to be addressed. Note that Basic Authentication is required for all requests
            as such, make sure to provide the Authorization header with a valid value. Should you choose to provide a callback url by
            using the 'WebhookUrl' field, we will send a HTTP POST request to that URL with a JSON payload containing the OrderId when
            specific events occur on the order.

404.description: Specified order template does not exist

500.description: An error occurred when trying to create the order
